mapper.sql: id, task_no, cust_id, source_type, source_biz_id, org_id, assignee_emp_id, task_type, task_status, plan_finish_time, warning_time, sla_status, success_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, lock_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE task_no=#{taskNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_biz_id=#{sourceBizId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE 1=1
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND plan_finish_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY plan_finish_time
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE cust_id=#{custId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE cust_id=#{custId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE assignee_emp_id=#{empId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE assignee_emp_id=#{empId} AND task_status=#{status} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE assignee_emp_id=#{empId} AND task_status IN #{status}
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE cust_id=#{custId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE cust_id=#{custId} AND org_id=#{orgCode} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE cust_id=#{custId} AND org_id=#{orgCode} AND task_type='FIRST_TOUCH' AND task_status='SUCCESS'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE org_id=#{orgCode} AND created_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND created_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND sla_status IN ('YELLOW','RED')

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,created_time,success_time)/60.0) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE org_id=#{orgCode} AND task_status='SUCCESS' AND success_time IS NOT NULL AND created_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00') AND created_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKETING_TOUCH_TASK WHERE 1=1 AND org_id=#{orgId}
